name: Dinis
description: PhD researcher in Information Management at NOVA IMS, Universidade Nova de Lisboa, and Ethereum Foundation PhD Fellow. At the Nova Blockchain Lab I lead the peer to peer energy market task of COMMUNITAS, a Horizon Europe project, and I built and run the Nova Cidade L3, the Arbitrum Orbit chain where its households trade energy every hour. My research is on blockchain settlement for energy communities and the privacy of the people in them, with a side line on LLMs for smart contract security. I studied computer science at Instituto Superior Técnico (MSc thesis on Solidity smart contract security) and worked as a Solidity developer and auditor before the PhD.
